merges.reason: The visitor Hyde transforms into Henry Jekyll before Lanyon's eyes

events.text: Hyde enters Lanyon's house and urgently asks if he has it
Lanyon rebukes Hyde for forgetting they are unacquainted
events.quote: You forget that I have not yet the pleasure of your acquaintance

events.text: Hyde says he comes at the instance of Dr. Henry Jekyll
events.quote: I come here at the instance of your colleague, Dr. Henry Jekyll

events.text: Lanyon points Hyde to the drawer holding the package
Hyde uncovers the contents and sobs with immense relief
events.quote: he uttered one loud sob of such immense relief

events.text: Hyde mixes the red tincture and powder into a changing compound
events.quote: measured out a few minims of the red tincture and added one of the powders

events.text: Hyde offers Lanyon knowledge and power or to leave unwiser
events.quote: a new province of knowledge and new avenues to fame and power

events.text: Lanyon agrees to see the end of the inexplicable service
events.quote: I have gone too far in the way of inexplicable services to pause before I see the end

events.text: Hyde drinks the glass at one gulp and cries out
events.quote: He put the glass to his lips and drank at one gulp

events.text: Hyde transforms and Henry Jekyll stands before Lanyon
Jekyll confesses his moral turpitude to Lanyon with tears
events.quote: the moral turpitude that man unveiled to me, even with tears of penitence

events.text: Lanyon learns the visitor was Hyde, murderer of Carew
events.quote: known by the name of Hyde and hunted for in every corner of the land as the murderer of Carew

attrs.value: life shaken, sleepless, believes he must die
attrs.quote: my days are numbered, and that I must die

attrs.value: clothes enormously too large for him
attrs.quote: enormously too large for him in every measurement

attrs.value: known by the name of Hyde
attrs.quote: known by the name of Hyde
